quote: In no case shall any part of any vehicle, part of the load of such vehicle or trailer attached to such vehicle, project into the street more than fifteen feet measured on a line at right angles to the curb.

activation.description: A vehicle, its load or attached trailer projects into the street from a curb.
activation.source_clause: any part of any vehicle, part of the load of such vehicle or trailer attached to such vehicle

obligation.description: Do not project more than fifteen feet into the street, measured at right angles to the curb.
obligation.source_clause: project into the street more than fifteen feet measured on a line at right angles to the curb

timing.description: Apply to the retained parked interval and its maximum full-part projection.
